data.gender_notes: Mukarrama is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘karrama’, meaning ‘to honor’ or ‘to glorify’. This name signifies bestowing honor and dignity upon someone, and seeking Allah's pleasure through good deeds. The name Mukarrama carries the meaning “Honor, Glory” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mukarrama usually hope their child will grow to embody honor, glory and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mukarrama total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
